monument_name: Haugaḥ Ganedyaḥ Phalcā (ca. mid-17th century CE)
description_en: Haugaḥ Ganedyaḥ Phalcā is located next to the main road at Haugala Ṭola. This south-facing Phalcā has five bays and a Gaṇeśa statue enshrined in the middle of its rear wall. It is worshipped by the Tāmrākāras, Śākyas, Maharjanas and Rājakarṇikāras of Haugala Ṭola. A pair of lions donated in NS 1028 (1908 CE) stand in front of the Gaṇeśa image and guard the site, whilst and a bell donated in NS 1016 (1896 CE) has been placed on the right corner of the Phalcā. A pair of rats made of metal has been installed in front of the Gaṇeśa shrine (rats are considered to be Gaṇeśa's avatar). Two brasstoraṇasare located above thekhopīwhere Gaṇeśa shrine is kept.Three aniconic stones worshipped as the forms of Bhairavaby can be found to the east of the shrine.The roof of the Phalcāis decorated with a metal pinnacle and umbrella, and a banner hangs down from the pinnacle to the edge of the roof. No documented evidence could be found to tell us about the date of the Phalcā's construction. However, thetoraṇadonated to the Gaṇeśa shrine in NS 796 suggests that the Gaṇeśa shrine must have been established some time before that.This Phalcāwas renovated in NS 930 (1810 CE) and NS 1028. The capital beams from the 18th century are preserved. The inscription found there informs us that it was renovated during the festivities celebrating King Vīrendra Śāha's 23rd year of his reign with the help of Department of Archaelogy, and the Nepal and German Governments. A Rājakaṛnikāra family of Haugaḥ Bāhāḥ displays a silver Gaṇeśa image at the Phalcāduring the Indrajātrā festival and a Jyāpu family displays apaubhāḥat the same time. The community of Jyāpus chantdāphā bhajanaat the Phalcā during the months of Kārtika and Māgha.
description_ne: हौगल टोलको मूल सडक छेउमा यो फल्चा बनेको छ । दक्षिणाभिमुख भई बनेको फल्चामा पाँच कवलहरू रहेका छन् । फल्चाको बीचमा गणेशको सानो शिखराखारमा बनाइएको संरचना रहेको छ जसलाई हौगलका ताम्राकार, शाक्य, महर्जन र राजकर्णिकार समुदायले स्थानगणेशको रूपमा पूज्ने गर्छन् । फल्चामा भएको गणेश मूर्ति भएको संरचना अगाडि एकजोडा सिंहमूर्ति छ जुन ने.सं. १०२८मा चढाइएको हो । त्यसैगरी फल्चाको दायाँ कुनामा ने.सं. १०१६मा स्थापित घण्टा रहेको छ । गणेशमूर्त्ति अगाडि एक जोडा मुसाका धातुमूर्ति पनि स्थापित छन् । गणेशको मूर्ति राखिएको खोपीमाथि सानो र ठुलो गरी पित्तलका दुई तोरण चढाइएका छन् । गणेश मूर्ति भएको संरचनाको पूर्वतिर तीनवटा अमूर्त ढुङ्गाहरू रहेका छन् जसलाई स्थानीयले भैरव मान्दै पूज्दै आएका छन् । फल्चाको छानामाथि छत्रसहितको धातुको गजूर छ भने गजूरदेखि छानाको तल्लो भागसम्म लत्किएको पताः पनि चढाइएको देख्न सकिन्छ ।यस फल्चाको निर्माणबारे जानकारी पाउन सकिने अभिलेख फल्चामा भेटिँदैन तर ने.सं. ७९६ मा गणेशलाई तोरण चढाइएको अभिलेख भएबाट त्यस ताका नै गणेशमूर्त्ति को अस्तित्व भएको ज्ञात हुन्छ । फल्चाको जीर्णोद्धार ने.सं.९३० र १०२८ मा भएको थियो । राजा विरेन्द्रको शाकनकालको २३ औं वर्षमा पनि फल्चाको जीर्णोद्धार पुरातत्व विभाग र जर्मन सरकारको सहयोगमा गरिएको चर्चा परेको अभिलेख फल्चामा प्राप्त छ । फल्चामा हौगःबहाःका एक राजकर्णीकार परिवारले इन्द्रजात्राको समय चाँदीको गणेश मूर्ति प्रदर्शनमा राख्ने परम्परा छ । त्यसैगरी सोही समय भौननिका ज्यापु परिवारले गणेशको चित्र अंकित पौभाः प्रदर्शनमा राख्ने चलन चल्दै आएको छ । फल्चामा गुँला, कार्तिक र माघ महिनामा ज्यापु समुदायबाट दाफा भजन गर्ने गरिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: A pair of lion statues was placed, one on each side of the steps leading up to the Gaṇeśa shrine by Gopāla Rājakarṇikāra, his wife Tuyumatī, Punavī, Ghālāla, Akṣilāla and Āśālāla.
The Phalcāwas renovated by Rājakarṇikāra Jīvanarasĩha.
Atoraṇawas offered to the the shrine of Gaṇeśa by Mādhava Dhãguri, Viśva Sĩha, Hidaya Bhāva, Viṣṇu Bhāva, Manirāma Bhāva, Bayana Sĩ Bhāva, Rugu Sĩ Bhāva, birāma Bhāva, Āpãlhāma Bhāva (among others).
A bell was placed at the left corner of the Phalcā,donated by Dhana Jyāpu, Bilanādã, Jyāpu, Devakṛṣṇa and Kṛṣṇa Jyāpu.

The Phalcāwas renovated and the ground floor was paved with stone. A fund for the renovation work was collected by Haugaḥ Bhajana Khalaḥ and Viddhyālāla Rājakarṇikāra. The inscription mentions the Phalcāas adegala(temple).
The Phalcāwas renovated during the reign of King Birendra with the help of Department of Archaeology, Nepal and the German Government.
A copperpatāḥ,a metal banner hanging from the pinnacle of a temple,was offered to the Gaṇeśa shrine by Sattu Maharjan, Rāmalāla Maharjan and their families.

A stonejarũhitihas beenattached to the western wall of the Phalcā byDãju Bhāro and Rājakarṇikāra Cikidhikala Bhāro. Land had also been donated for its annual function. The inscription also mentions about the necessity of giving certain amount of paddy (45 Pāthis) to a person who fills up water in thejarũhitieveryday. According toFurukawa/Shrestha/Bajracharya and Ogasawara 2010(p. 121) the water tank was built in the Malla period.
